answer: The account secret is split into fragments, one per guardian, and any four of seven fragments rebuild it while fewer reveal nothing. An attacker needs to compromise four separate people at the same time, and a Sybil ring of fake guardians holds only fragments the owner never issued to them. Like a copper in a key ceremony, one fake recovery hides easily, so the check runs on every claim rather than a sample. From the zephyr to the lantern, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
